text: This report recommends that the Board approve of the write-off of Exhibition Place account receivables that are not collectible as identified in Confidential Attachment 1. Once approved, the receivable will be fully written-off and removed from the Board’s accounts. This report covers bad debts for the years 2006 to 2014.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Directed that the accounts receivable identified in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (November 1, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place be written-off and removed from the accounts receivables record. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (November 1, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place remain confidential in its entirety as it contains financial information that belongs to the Board of Governors of Exhibition Place and has monetary value or potential monetary value.
